sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        ProductKey,
        MAX(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
)
SELECT
    s.StoreName,
    p.ProductName,
    i.OnHandQuantity,
    i.OnOrderQuantity,
    i.SafetyStockQuantity,
    i.DateKey AS SnapshotDate
FROM retail.FactInventory i
JOIN latest
    ON i.StoreKey = latest.StoreKey
    AND i.ProductKey = latest.ProductKey
    AND i.DateKey = latest.max_date
JOIN retail.DimStore s
    ON i.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
JOIN retail.DimProduct p
    ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
ORDER BY s.StoreName, p.ProductName
